title: Detailed robot vacuum
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- shadow/body base -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="38" ry="14" fill="#2a2a5a"/>
  <!-- main body top -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="38" ry="16" fill="#4a4a8a"/>
  <!-- body side/bumper -->
  <path d="M12 62 Q12 82 50 82 Q88 82 88 62" fill="#3a3a7a" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- bumper highlight -->
  <path d="M14 66 Q14 80 50 80 Q86 80 86 66" fill="none" stroke="#6a6ab0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- top circular panel -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="28" ry="10" fill="#5a5aa0"/>
  <!-- center dark circle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="12" ry="5" fill="#1a1a4a"/>
  <!-- sensor bump -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#7a7ac0"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#3a3a8a"/>
  <!-- LED ring on sensor -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="6.5" ry="3.2" fill="none" stroke="#66ddaa" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- green status light -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="54" r="1.5" fill="#88ffbb"/>
  <!-- side brushes left -->
  <g stroke="#88ccff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="18" y1="70" x2="8" y2="76"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="70" x2="10" y2="66"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="70" x2="12" y2="80"/>
    <line x1="10" y1="66" x2="6" y2="60"/>
    <line x1="8" y1="76" x2="4" y2="82"/>
    <line x1="12" y1="80" x2="10" y2="88"/>
  </g>
  <!-- side brushes right -->
  <g stroke="#88ccff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="82" y1="70" x2="92" y2="76"/>
    <line x1="82" y1="70" x2="90" y2="66"/>
    <line x1="82" y1="70" x2="88" y2="80"/>
    <line x1="90" y1="66" x2="94" y2="60"/>
    <line x1="92" y1="76" x2="96" y2="82"/>
    <line x1="88" y1="80" x2="90" y2="88"/>
  </g>
  <!-- spinning brush centers -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="70" r="2.5" fill="#aaddff"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="70" r="2.5" fill="#aaddff"/>
  <!-- front sensor strip -->
  <rect x="35" y="74" rx="2" ry="2" width="30" height="5" fill="#1a1a3a"/>
  <rect x="37" y="75.5" rx="1" ry="1" width="8" height="2" fill="#ffcc44"/>
  <rect x="47" y="75.5" rx="1" ry="1" width="6" height="2" fill="#44ccff"/>
  <rect x="55" y="75.5" rx="1" ry="1" width="8" height="2" fill="#ffcc44"/>
  <!-- wheel hints -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="81" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#2a2a5a"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="81" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#2a2a5a"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="81" rx="3" ry="1.8" fill="#6a6ab0"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="81" rx="3" ry="1.8" fill="#6a6ab0"/>
  <!-- top highlight shine -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="56" rx="10" ry="3" fill="#7a7ac0" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
